about.description: This tool automatically identifies your movies and TV shows using popular databases, then streamlines the entire process: rename files using Plex-friendly conventions, attach artwork, correct metadata (including track language and type), split or join media files and encode to H.264 or H.265—all in one place.
about.features.audio_subtitle_management: Detects and labels audio/subtitle languages; renames and reorders tracks.
about.features.automatic_media_recogniti: Identifies movies and TV shows using TheMovieDB or TVDB
about.features.batch_processing.descript: Handles multiple files simultaneously with queue management.
about.features.batch_processing.title: Batch Processing:
about.features.media_splitting_joining.d: Splits large files or joins multiple parts (e.g., DVD1/DVD2) into one.
about.features.metadata_correction.descr: Fetches and corrects title, year, episode name...
about.features.metadata_correction.title: Metadata Correction:
about.features.smart_file_renaming.descr: Renames files using Plex/Kodi-friendly naming conventions
about.features.smart_file_renaming.title: Smart File Renaming:
about.features.video_encoding.descriptio: Converts media to efficient formats with predefined presets.
about.features.video_encoding.title: Video Encoding (H.264 / H.265):
about.news.version_1_6_1.items:
Display a warning message if application can''t access removable medias (snap)
Added What''s new section in about dialog
Added Features section in about dialog
about.news.version_1_6_2.items:
Support drag and drop movie parts
Display progression while generating preview
High speed conversion of files if format is not supported for preview
Fixed issue with second part joining and trimming
about.news.version_1_6_3.items:
Re-encode on Codec Mismatch Setting
Fix issue with multi encode
Fix matching of series even if no episode number specified
about.news.version_1_6_4.items:
Improve absolute episode number matching (good for mangas)
Improve UI performance
Response caching for TVDB and TMDB
about.news.version_1_6_5.items:
Fix issues with track encoding selection
Show mixed selection if different data on multi select
about.news.version_1_6_7.items:
Fix preview not showing regression
New packaging to fix security issues
about.news.version_1_7_0.items:
Redesigned TV show matching with more search options (by title, TVDB ID, episode number or episode name)
Improved episode matching for absolute-numbered series
Better handling of missing or not-found episodes with clearer messages
about.news.version_1_7_1.items:
Fixed default search mode when parsing movie and TV show filenames
Fixed series poster being downloaded to the wrong or duplicate location
Improved track language detection when using manual hints
UI consistency improvements for settings and multi-file matching
about.news.version_1_7_2.items:
Reworked filename parser for more reliable movie and TV show identification
Added JDownloader EventScripter integration for automated download handling
Improved build and packaging workflows
Various bug fixes and UI polish
about.news.version_1_8_2.items:
Opening a video file from the Windows right-click menu now works for the Microsoft Store version
Now only the language selector in Settings shows the English name of each language next to its translation
about.news.version_1_8_3.items:
Added Output Rules to route processed videos to custom directories based on type, language, year, genres, country or quality
Improved filename parsing for franchise-style movie titles with a year separator
Fixed language matching for output rules so a region-less code like fr correctly matches fr-FR

Added a shutdown button to the main toolbar to turn off the computer when all processing is complete
Added an option to delete source files after they are processed
Added Arabic (ar-SA) to the Microsoft Store listing
Declared all 23 supported languages in the Windows Store package
Encoding job progress messages are now translated based on the selected language
TV shows using absolute episode numbering are no longer placed in a season subfolder

about.news.version_1_8_5.items:
The Cancel toolbar action now also removes selected videos that are waiting in the queue and resets them to the ready-to-process state
The application log viewer is now available in a new "Logs" tab in the About dialog instead of the main toolbar
Video status messages (info, warning and error) are now also emitted to the event log
Custom videos now display a warning asking the user to complete the required information before processing
Multi-search now continues with the remaining selected videos if one search fails, preventing the multi-selection panels from staying disabled
Auto-start mode is now disabled for videos that have been canceled or manually searched, preventing them from automatically processing again
about.news.version_1_8_6.items:
Fixed a Fluent UI runtime error that could break the About and other dialogs
Updated the JDownloader integration to support both Linux and Windows and to launch Smart Video Processor in the background
Improved dependency resolution for Fluent UI and build tooling
about.news.version_1_8_8.items:
Added automatic "Spectacle" genre detection for live performances (one-man show, stand-up comedy, theater play, concert, live performance, etc.) when retrieving movie details from TMDB
Cleanup progress dialog now uses translated messages and the correct application icon
about.news.version_1_8_7.items:
Added a cleanup progress dialog that shows the deletion progress of temporary files when closing the application
Fixed escaped newlines in the What's New list for version 1.8.5 so each item renders as a separate bullet
